name: Cobb Salad with Chicken, Bacon, Egg, Tomato, Blue Cheese & Dijon Vinaigrette (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 large and 4 mini food storage containers.
Place eggs in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice bacon.

Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate; set aside. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)

While the bacon is cooking, pat the chicken dry with paper towels. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the bacon is done, return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside to cool.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Divide between the mini containers and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 clove garlic
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Divide between the large containers.
Wash, dry, and halve grape tomatoes. Add to the containers with the lettuce.
When the eggs are cool, peel and roughly chop. Add to the containers.
When the chicken is cool, roughly chop. Add to the containers along with crispy bacon and blue cheese.
Cover large and mini containers, then refrigerate until ready to eat. Drizzle salad with dressing and enjoy!
